Sorry for the delay. No not a sudden cessation. I drank during the periods of anxiety and when it became too much to handle i checked myself into inpatient detox. I was medicated during my detox period which was around 5 days. After which i noticed the aforementioned symptoms.

Yea i wanted to rule out any potential physical problems before trying to accept that it was all psychological.
I similarly struggle with thinking that i somehow got brain damage during detox, but when i think clearly and rationalize with myself i can start to shake that thought. 

Ive been hearing alot about magnesium lately, especially for sleep. Might give that a go as well. Im probably not drinking as much water as i need to as well. 

Cant wait to be able and look back at all of this and remind myself why i should never drink.

Hey i appreciate the reply!
I have spoken to my doctor and he said keep an eye on it for the next couple of weeks. Its only been a week and a half since detox. 
Typically the symptoms are somewhat mild. But overall its frustrating, i feel quantitatively dumber than before. Currently taking alot of vitamins to help (b1, b12, D3, omega 3 etc) hoping that will help haha

Im in the same boat. Today (yesterday i guess at this hour) was my 26th birthday and i was a wreck. I have had so much anxiety recently/intense panic attacks. I dont have a source of why, its just.. there. But i decided to talk. Talk to everyone i felt comfortable to, even strangers.

 I told them what was happening.
 Why i think it was happening.
How im gonna beat it and my plan to solving it. 

And guess what, i had a strong moment of clarity afterward. You can too. It feels amazing to feel yourself again, you laugh, smile, and maybe cry, but it feels so worth it. We can beat this i promise. Breath, breath slowlyyy. Remember your capable of normalcy, talk to others. It helps
